programme.desc: Rob Beckett and Zoe Lyons join team captains Steve and Sam and host Dara as they compete across a series of video games including Gran Turismo, Horace Goes Skiing, Whac-a-Mole and Goat Simulator.

programme.title: Love of a Forgotten Century
programme.desc: Tea merchant To Chung-yuen is the owner of Sun Cheung Ho Tea Plantation in Yunnan that has been passed down through generations and his sons, To Yu-shu and To Yu-lau, follow in his footsteps and join the family business.

programme.title: Deep in the Realm of Conscience
programme.desc: During the reign of Emperor Shang of Tang, Li Longji and his aunt, Princess Taiping, launch a coup that restores Prince of Xiang, Li Dan to the throne.

programme.title: When Heaven Burns
programme.desc: Chun-Hung asked Chun-Hin to falsify the company's financial records so that the company can go public.

programme.title: When Heaven Burns
programme.desc: Yi-Long needed help from Lui Yiu-Bun; however, Yiu-Bun is only willing to help him if he can sleep with Lam Pui-Ling.

programme.title: Grace Under Fire
programme.desc: Hung stops his students from teaching Wai a good lesson; Wai leaves Po Chi Lam after Hung refuses to fight with him; when Lan brings Lung's medicine to his home, a man with leprosy attacks her.

programme.title: No Return
programme.desc: Experience the pinnacle of Chinese drama with TVB Pearl Drama Channel, showcasing the best of kung fu, drama, period pieces, action, and romance. Embrace the finest of each genre, your ultimate destination for exceptional Chinese drama.

programme.title: Unwanted Soldiers
programme.desc: Filmmaker Jari Osborne discovers her father's WWII involvement, revealing discrimination against Chinese-Canadians. His secret missions in Southeast Asia shed light on their quiet heroism, paying moving tribute in this multi-layered documentary.

programme.title: Challenger An Industrial Romance
programme.desc: Follows the development of Canadair's super-executive jet. The film captures the spirit of the Canadian air transport industry and its attempt to compete with the American leaders in the industry.

programme.title: Illuminated Lives A Brief History Of Womens Work In The Middle Ages
programme.desc: The popular image of the Middle Ages comes from fairy tales and romances. This animated short challenges some enduring myths about medieval women and shows what their lives were really like.

programme.title: In Full Voice
programme.desc: Muslim women are disconcerting, intriguing, polarizing—and straitjacketed by conflations of ideas in front-page stories. The film sits down with six Muslim Canadian women eager to talk about what shapes their identities.

programme.title: Sunrise Over Tiananmen Square
programme.desc: Shui-Bo Wang's animated documentary intertwines personal journey with history, exploring China's '60s-'80s upheavals. From symbol of hope to tragedy, it depicts Wang's roles from Red Guard to teacher, exploring idealism and intolerance.

programme.title: Safe Distance, A
programme.desc: A Safe Distance examines the services needed by and available to battered women. The film looks at some innovative approaches to providing services and accommodation for battered women in rural, northern, and Native communities.

programme.title: Strings
programme.desc: Strings: a haunting film of intimate strangers linked by shared spaces. Comfortable connections fracture when a problem arises. Created with glass painting and stop-motion, it's visually stunning.

programme.title: Laila
programme.desc: Laila Paattinen is a working woman. Tired of low-paying jobs, she completed a five-month course in dry-wall installation. Because she had chosen a non-traditional job for women, she solved her problems by opening her own dry-wall application business.

programme.title: Toward Intimacy
programme.desc: "Toward Intimacy" celebrates the rights of women with disabilities to pursue intimate relationships. This one-hour film features personal stories from four Canadian women, addressing sexuality, self-esteem, stereotypes, and parenting.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: The semifinals begin in Los Angeles, where the competing ninjas will face up to 10 challenging obstacles, including new obstacles Wall-to-Wall and the Inverter; the top two runs of the night will face off in the Power Tower.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: The semifinals continue as competitors face up to 10 obstacles, including the new obstacle Padlock; for Split Decision, the ninjas must choose between an upper-body and balance obstacle; the top two runs of the night face off on the Power Tower.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: The semifinals continue as competitors face up to 10 obstacles, including the new obstacle Drop Zone; for Split Decision, the ninjas must choose between an upper-body and balance obstacle; the top two runs of the night face off on the Power Tower.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: The semifinals conclude in Los Angeles as competing ninjas face up to 10 challenging obstacles; for Split Decision, ninjas must choose between an upper body and balance obstacle; the top two runs of the night will face off in the Power Tower.

programme.title: Bullish With Sonali Basak
programme.desc: Building wealth used to follow a formula, but these days it's easier than ever to play the markets. With investing tools at everyone's fingertips, is it a chance for generational wealth or a siren call for suckers?

programme.title: Bullish With Sonali Basak
programme.desc: Finance is an industry dominated by men, but women are rising and controlling more wealth globally; how did the women of Wall Street break through, and what's changing now that they have?

programme.title: Bloomberg The Asia Trade
programme.desc: Bringing global investors everything you need to know as the trading day begins in Asia. Bloomberg TV is live from Tokyo and Sydney with Shery Ahn and Haidi Stroud-Watts, getting insight and analysis from newsmakers and industry leaders.

programme.title: Bloomberg: The China Show
programme.desc: From politics and policy to tech and trends, Yvonne Man and David Ingles give global investors insight into the world's second-biggest economy, delivering in-depth discussions with newsmakers.
